description: This file contains unit tests for the FrameType template class in the WPEFramework Core library. It tests buffer setting, copying, reading, and other functionalities of the FrameType class.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A template class in WPEFramework Core used to handle frame buffer operations with fixed size blocks.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets the buffer with data from an array, returning the number of bytes written.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves data from the buffer into an array, returning the number of bytes read.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the frame buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the buffer, resetting its state.

methods.name: UnlockBuffer
methods.description: Unlocks or releases the buffer at a given offset.
